title: PTP device-info decoders discard the received payload boundary
summary: Device-info path passes payload without remaining length into primitive/string/array decoders. Isolated helper diagnostic demonstrates missing bounds, not full transport reachability because transport adds padding. Next: bounded cursor parsing and fake transport short/oversized count regressions.

resolution.evidence: 20261025093224-2d50-fix-ptp-findings/verification.md; ptp_decode_device_info() decodes within the received size with bounded readers, strings are terminated and arrays keep at most PTP_MAX_ELEMENTS - 1 codes (indigo_ccd_ptp 3.0.0.56); device_info_truncated, device_info_exact_buffer, device_info_short_array, device_info_oversized_array
